# RINGFALL: CHAOS CIRCUIT

FRWF is a browser wrestling game. Fresh local setup defaults to Singles; Battle Royale provides five-wrestler free-for-all play, target cycling and spectator controls. Five selectable wrestlers share a skinned character asset pipeline. Standard and Chaos rules support strikes, guard, counters, grappling, throws, pinfall, knockout, props, turnbuckle attacks and explicit ring/ringside traversal. Arcade controls provide consistent basic attacks and approach assistance; Technical controls retain directional move selection.

Explore Showground is a first connected world slice: walk through the yard, backstage and ringside, approach six encounter hosts, enter instanced backyard, backstage or Volt Dome bouts and return to your previous world position. The arena includes ropes, steps, props, commentary desk and barricades. Easy rivals allow a five-second opening and slower decisions. Outdoor and backstage bouts use a continuous physical floor, solid visible boundaries, breakable wooden tables and venue-aware context actions. Local circuit objectives reward victories, two completed grapples in a win, and pinfall or finisher wins; distinct victories unlock harder encounters. Repeating a completed objective does not farm reputation. Exploration-to-combat handoff, cloud progression and real motion-captured move clips remain separate concerns: scene handoff exists, cloud progression and captured motion do not. Current movement, recovery and visual quality remain under active repair; tests or authored move definitions do not certify satisfying gameplay.

The Vite/React browser client loads bundled glTF characters, Hollow Point Ritual background music, a real crowd sample and silent original FRWF archive footage. Settings include independent music/effects/crowd volume, reduced motion, camera cuts and adaptive graphics. Archive footage is background media, not motion capture. Character and media provenance accompany the bundled assets.

Local match state stays in memory; settings and validated showground position, visited areas, completed bout records and objective medals use optional localStorage. These editable device-local records are not a trusted leaderboard. Local play requires no account. An optional Colyseus client connects to a separately configured online service. The repository also contains a separate Cloudflare backend implementation; it is not wired into the browser transport and its existence does not establish production availability. Frontend static discovery does not certify online service health, trace export or platform-wide compliance.

Public frontend discovery routes: /api/health, /api/v1/health, /api/docs, /openapi.yaml, /llms.txt, /llms-full.txt, /llms-index.json, /robots.txt, /sitemap.xml, /sitemap-index.xml, /rss.xml, /feed.xml, /manifest.webmanifest, /.well-known/mcp.json, /.well-known/agents.json, /.well-known/security.txt, /.well-known/trust.json.
